title: Maintainer receives routed score diagnostics for missing readings
summary: Score computation reports missing reading inputs through the typed command router without a raw stack while preserving valid score results.
preconditions: A valid reading fixture and a missing-readings fixture are available

steps.action: Run score computation with the required readings absent
steps.expected_outcome: The command returns a typed actionable diagnostic and no raw stack trace

steps.action: Run score computation with a valid fixed reading set
steps.expected_outcome: The deterministic score result remains unchanged

postconditions: Missing-input and valid-input outcomes are stable and separately testable

acceptance_criteria.statement: Missing readings produce a typed actionable router diagnostic without a raw stack trace.
Valid score computation remains deterministic and bounded.
